subject: Vision pilot — cost check-in, pilot credits & next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@vectoreyes.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — vision pilot next steps

Hi Priya — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups from our side so we can finalize the pilot economics: 

- Observed workload: you mentioned ~3–5 inference calls per user per day, average image size ~1.5MB (pre-processed to 512x512).
- Expected pilot cohort: ~1k MAUs to start, scaling to ~10k over 3 months if metrics look good.
- Typical response: 250–800 tokens per request after image-caption and metadata steps.

To price the pilot properly we need two quick clarifications: 1) typical tokens/request you want us to optimize for (choose a 95th percentile if there is variability), and 2) target monthly budget range for the pilot (this helps us size credits and burst capacity).

Attached a short worksheet that maps tokens->cost at several unit price points; we can adjust to your preferred $/1M token target. If you confirm a budget range, Marcus and I can propose a credit top-up and a 30-day burn-safeguard.

Next steps I suggest:
- Priya: confirm tokens/request (P50 / P95) and pilot budget window by Tue EOD.
- Marcus/Aditya: provide proposed credit top-up and instrumentation checklist.
- Schedule a 30-minute check-in in two weeks to review telemetry.

Thanks — 
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(she/her)

-- Attachment: vision-pilot-metrics.pdf (1 page)
-- Attachment: pilot-instrumentation-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priya Shah <priya@vectoreyes.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — vision pilot next steps

Hi Sofia — great recap and thanks for the worksheet. Answers below: 

- Tokens per request: median ~360 tokens, P95 ~720 tokens (we include both caption + downstream prompt tokens).
- Pilot cohort & cadence: we'll start with 1k MAUs for 30 days; if conversion metrics look promising we expect to ramp to 8–10k MAUs over 90 days.
- Budget range: for the initial pilot our budget is roughly $12k–$25k for the month (includes infra + model costs). Our procurement lead prefers pilot credits rather than an up-front committed spend.

Request: would Redwood be able to provide a temporary credit top-up to cover ~$20k of model spend for 30 days? We'll instrument the events you requested and share telemetry.

Also looping in our engineering lead if needed for instrumentation: akash@vectoreyes.ai (should we include him on the next check-in?)

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, VectorEyes

On Mon, Aug 2, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Priya — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya@vectoreyes.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — vision pilot next steps

Thanks for the clarity Priya. We can support a short-term credit bridge for the pilot. Proposed terms: 

- Offer: $20,000 in pilot credits redeemable against hosted inference usage for 30 days from activation.
- Safeguard: automatic throttle at 90% of credit consumption with a notification to your billing contact and the Redwood account team.
- Unit economics assumption: we'll price on a $1,000 per 1M-token baseline for the pilot (we can tighten this after we see token distribution), which maps to roughly ~20M tokens of usable capacity under the credit.

Ask from VectorEyes: please confirm the P95 token distribution and expected concurrency (QPS) during the pilot. For instrumentation we require: request_id propagation, sample request payloads, and a success/error tag in your telemetry. I've attached a short checklist and will create a HubSpot task.

Aditya — can you confirm any procurement paperwork or special SCC/contract needs?

Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: pilot-instrumentation-checklist.xlsx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@vectoreyes.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — vision pilot next steps

Priya — fantastic, thanks for confirming the numbers. Summary & immediate asks so we can activate the credits: 

1) VectorEyes confirms P95 ~720 tokens/request and expected initial concurrency ~15–25 QPS during sample windows.
2) We will provision a $20k credit for 30 days. Activation date is the day you flip the pilot to "live" (we will provide the activation link).
3) Required: add request_id to headers and enable a billing-contact email to receive consumption alerts (please give us the email by EOD Thu).

Next steps (short timeline):
- Today: Aditya to send the DocuSign for the pilot credit agreement and our standard data processing addendum.
- Tomorrow: VectorEyes to confirm billing contact and provide a brief sample payload (anonymized).
- In 14 days: 30-minute telemetry check-in (I’ll send a calendar invite once activation is confirmed).

Thanks all — excited to get this running.

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com
